metadata.notes: DeepSeek Harness loads project AGENTS.md instructions and stores full assistant text; the DSH parser scans that text for task estimates, but the driver lacks the required pre-launch seed_instruction step.

assessment.body:
## Verdict

agent_supports: yes
daemon_capability: full
driver_capability: gap:seed_instruction

## Reasoning

DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.2 explicitly supports the required persistent instruction surface. Its installed `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions` package states that `dsh-base` enables workspace instructions by default, loads project `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` candidates on the first request, and injects each message into the model verbatim. The active TUI profile composes `dsh-base` and includes the `agent-instructions` plugin with a 65,536-byte budget. This is direct evidence that a fenced marker rule in the run cwd's `AGENTS.md` reaches the model. Actual repeated marker emission remains model-discretion and must be settled by the recording.

The DSH adapter has the complete daemon path. `parseAssistantMessage` joins every assistant text block into full text and calls `tailer.ScanTaskEstimate` before display truncation. The shared scanner selects the most recent valid `irrlicht-eta` HTML comment and stamps it with the durable event time. The tailer retains the first and latest estimates. The metrics adapter converts the estimate to the domain form and calls `ForecastTaskCompletion`; the web client suppresses the ETA presentation outside `working`. DSH `turn/start` and completed `turn/end` records also produce the required single-session ready-to-working-to-ready lifecycle. No spec-required signal lacks a producing path, so daemon capability is full.

The recipe requires a `seed_instruction` step because the scenario requires a persistent instruction-file rule. The current DeepSeek Harness driver declares and dispatches send, slash, wait_turn, sleep, interrupt, keys, reset_session, restart, resume, sigkill, exit_clean, start_session, and session, but not `seed_instruction`. It also boots the first TUI slot before entering its script loop. Record must therefore port a pre-launch seed pass that writes the recipe's `AGENTS.md` under `$RUN_CWD` before `boot_slot`. This is a driver tooling gap, not an observability limit.

The recipe uses five driven turns. The seeded rule is the only place that contains the marker format. Turn zero reports 0/4 without doing a phase. Four later turns complete one phase each and reach 4/4. A 12-second delay follows each intermediate turn and a 30-second final delay matches the conservative sibling timing for this scenario. The model and endpoint are pinned by the existing driver settings, and the live `/v1/models` probe on 2026-09-19 confirmed `qwen/qwen3.5-9b` is available.
caveats: Vacuous-pass condition: the cell would not prove that the seeded project rule loaded if another applicable $DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md, ancestor AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, or a prompt already supplied the marker format. At record time, confirm that the seeded $RUN_CWD/AGENTS.md is the only applicable instruction file containing irrlicht-eta. The recipe prompts intentionally omit the marker syntax, and transcript assertions require exact 0/4 through 4/4 comments.

Repeated emission is model-discretion. The package contract proves that the instruction reaches the model and the durable transcript preserves assistant messages, but only a live recording can confirm that qwen/qwen3.5-9b emits the exact marker on every driven turn.

The driver gap must be implemented as a pre-launch pass. Handling seed_instruction only inside the current dispatch loop is too late because boot_slot runs before that loop and the instruction plugin loads the baseline on the first request.

LM Studio at http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1 with qwen/qwen3.5-9b loaded is load-bearing. The exact model and non-zero token observations depend on this endpoint. The local route has no required non-zero cost.

State-only phases would prove only lifecycle. The transcript assertions are load-bearing because they require each exact parseable marker from completed_rounds 0 through 4. The recipe verify checks the derived estimate and ETA semantics that the lifecycle phase DSL cannot express.

sources.note: Official installed 0.1.5-rc.2 package reference: dsh-base enables the plugin, the first request loads the project AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md chain, and injected messages reach the model verbatim.
Identifies version 0.1.5-rc.2 and the official deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness source directory packages/context/agent-instructions.
parseAssistantText scans the full joined assistant text with tailer.ScanTaskEstimate before TruncateAssistantText and maps turn boundaries, model, and token usage.
Parses the latest valid irrlicht-eta HTML comment from full assistant text and stamps it with the event time.
Converts tailer task estimates to session metrics and computes task_completion_eta with ForecastTaskCompletion.
Defines TaskEstimate and the production completion forecast from observed progress.
The task ETA presentation gate suppresses the task estimate outside the working state.
DRIVE_ELICITS and the dispatch switch omit seed_instruction; boot_slot executes before the script loop, so seeding must occur in a new pre-launch pass.
Established DSH single-birth lifecycle, exact qwen/qwen3.5-9b driver setting, non-zero assistant usage, and local zero-cost observation precedent.
Sibling recipe supplies the 12-second inter-turn and 30-second final settle timing for the same daemon observation windows.

preconditions: dsh >=0.1.5-rc.2 is on PATH and the active TUI profile composes dsh-base with @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions enabled
LM Studio is serving qwen/qwen3.5-9b through http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1
tmux and zstd are installed, and irrlichd is recording the deepseek-harness adapter with transcript permission granted

Re-probe the applicable instruction chain at record time and confirm no $DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md, ancestor AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, or local overlay other than the seeded $RUN_CWD/AGENTS.md contains irrlicht-eta
setup: Port seed_instruction as a pre-launch driver pass: write the recipe text to $RUN_CWD/AGENTS.md before the initial boot_slot call. The later dispatch write is idempotent.
Let the existing driver create a fresh cwd, apply its temporary LM Studio model patch, and resolve the new durable DSH transcript by marker and exact header cwd.
Do not add the marker format to any send prompt. The seeded project instruction must remain the only source of the format.

script.text:
# Project instructions

## Task progress marker

While you work on a multi-phase task, emit exactly one hidden progress marker in your own assistant reply text on every turn. Use this exact compact HTML-comment form:

```
<!-- {"marker":"irrlicht-eta","total_rounds":N,"completed_rounds":M} -->
```

Set total_rounds to the planned number of phases. Before work starts, emit completed_rounds=0. Increase completed_rounds by exactly one after each phase. Keep total_rounds fixed. Emit completed_rounds=total_rounds after the final phase. Put the marker immediately before the final literal status token requested by the user.

Do not call tools or inspect files. This is a self-contained writing exercise. In one sentence, name the four phases for a technical note about deterministic replay: outline, introduction, body, and conclusion. Do not perform a phase yet. Include the hidden progress marker required by AGENTS.md in your assistant reply. End with the literal token PHASE0.

Do not call tools or inspect files. Complete phase 1 only: write a short outline for the technical note. Include the hidden progress marker required by AGENTS.md in your assistant reply. End with the literal token PHASE1.

Do not call tools or inspect files. Complete phase 2 only: write a short introduction for the technical note. Include the hidden progress marker required by AGENTS.md in your assistant reply. End with the literal token PHASE2.

Do not call tools or inspect files. Complete phase 3 only: write the short body for the technical note. Include the hidden progress marker required by AGENTS.md in your assistant reply. End with the literal token PHASE3.

Do not call tools or inspect files. Complete phase 4 only: write the short conclusion and finish the technical note. Include the hidden progress marker required by AGENTS.md in your assistant reply. End with the literal token DONE.

verify: The durable transcript has exactly one parseable irrlicht-eta marker for each progress value 0/4, 1/4, 2/4, 3/4, and 4/4; the marker format comes only from the seeded AGENTS.md.
While each marker turn is working, task_estimate.total_rounds is 4 and completed_rounds matches the latest marker; completed_rounds is non-decreasing and reaches 4.
task_estimate.updated_at advances for every fresher marker.
task_completion_eta is present after progress is measurable and a later projection is not later than an earlier projection.
The user-visible task estimate and ETA are present only while working and are suppressed after the final ready state.
The one DSH session follows ready -> working -> ready and finishes ready without a waiting transition.
The recording reports agent deepseek-harness, model qwen/qwen3.5-9b, non-zero tokens, and no required non-zero cost.
recipe.scope_note: The first staged run loaded the seeded rule but timed out before completing its first turn: the model made 28 file-inspection tool steps and emitted no marker. The revised prompts make the note self-contained, forbid tools, and point to the seeded rule without repeating the marker syntax. The 12-second inter-turn sleeps and 30-second final sleep match the conservative claudecode, gemini-cli, and mistral-vibe siblings.
